integrationsShowcase.title: Immich
integrationsShowcase.description: Self-hosted photo and video backup solution. Connect your Immich instance to display your photos on the map at the exact locations they were taken.

integrationsShowcase.title: PhotoPrism
integrationsShowcase.description: AI-powered photo management app. Integrate PhotoPrism to see your entire photo library on your location timeline.

benefits.title: Photos on Map
benefits.description: See all your photos plotted on the interactive map at their exact GPS coordinates. Rediscover where each memory was made.

benefits.title: Photos in Trips
benefits.description: Trip pages automatically show photos taken during that trip. Your travel journal becomes a rich multimedia experience.

benefits.title: Photo Timeline
benefits.description: Browse your photos chronologically alongside your location data. See the complete story of each day.

benefits.title: Privacy Preserved
benefits.description: Dawarich never stores your photos. It only reads location data from your self-hosted photo apps via their APIs.

setupSteps.title: Get API Keys
setupSteps.description: Generate API keys from your Immich or PhotoPrism instance.
details: Immich: Create key with asset.read and asset.view scopes (asset.update for Enrich Photos)
PhotoPrism: Generate key in Apps and Devices settings

setupSteps.title: Configure in Dawarich
setupSteps.description: Enter your photo service details in Dawarich settings.

setupSteps.title: Sync Complete
setupSteps.description: Dawarich connects to your photo service and indexes location data.
details: No photos are copied or stored

setupSteps.title: View Photos
setupSteps.description: Photos now appear on your map and in your trips.
details: Enable Photos layer on the map

hero.title: Connect Your
hero.subtitle: Bring your photos into your location timeline. Dawarich integrates with Immich and PhotoPrism to display your photos on the map and in trips—turning your location history into a rich, visual experience.

integrationsPage.heading: Why Photo Integration?
integrationsPage.p: Your location data becomes more meaningful when combined with the photos you took. Rediscover memories by seeing exactly where each photo was taken.
integrationsPage.subtitle2: Dawarich works seamlessly with popular self-hosted photo management solutions.
integrationsPage.subtitle3: Connect your photo library to Dawarich in just a few steps.
integrationsPage.p2: Dawarich **does not store or copy your photos**. It only reads location metadata from your self-hosted photo service via its API. Your photos remain safely in your Immich or PhotoPrism instance, under your complete control.
integrationsPage.Link: How to obtain Immich API key →
integrationsPage.p3: Generate an API key in PhotoPrism's "Apps and Devices" settings. Dawarich uses this to access your photo library and extract location information.
integrationsPage.Link2: How to obtain PhotoPrism API key →
integrationsPage.p4: Have an integration idea? [Share it on our community forum!](https://discourse.dawarich.app/).
integrationsPage.p5: Start seeing your photos on the map with a free Dawarich account.
integrationsPage.p6: 7-day free trial · 14-day risk-free refund · Cancel anytime
integrationsPage.immichScopes: Requires an API key with `asset.read` and `asset.view` scopes. Add `asset.update` if you also want to use the Enrich Photos feature. Dawarich queries the Immich API to read photo metadata including GPS coordinates from EXIF data.
